## How to Play Cross for Cash: Tips to Hop, Dodge, and Win


- by Skillz
- Oct. 20, 2026
- 5 min read


-
-
-
-


One hop gets you past traffic. The next puts you in front of a train. In


**Cross for Cash** , every move is a choice between pushing for a higher score and keeping your run alive.


This lane-crossing arcade game from ePlay Studios challenges you to dodge cars, cross rivers, and time your way past trains. Your score is matched against another player in Skillz tournaments, so quick reflexes help, but knowing when to wait matters just as much.


New to the game? This guide covers how to play Cross for Cash, what the powerups do, how tournaments work, and practical tips to help you survive longer and score higher.


###### **What Is Cross for Cash?**


Cross for Cash is a fast-paced arcade game from ePlay Studios, available on iPhone and iPad and powered by Skillz tournaments. Your goal is simple: move your character forward, dodge everything in your path, and survive as long as you can.


Every run is scored, and your score is compared against players with similar skill. That means the outcome comes down to your timing, reflexes, and decisions, not chance.


The game is free to download. Players must be 18 or older, and cash tournaments are only offered where permitted by law.


###### **How to Play Cross for Cash**


Cross for Cash uses simple tap and swipe controls, so you can learn it in seconds. The challenge is reading the board and moving at the right moment.


1. **Start your run.** Your animal character begins at the bottom of the screen facing a stretch of lanes.


2. **Hop forward.** Tap to move ahead one space at a time. Each step forward adds to your score.


3. **Move in any direction.** Swipe left or right to line up your next hop, or swipe back to retreat from danger.


4. **Dodge traffic.** Cars and trucks move across the road lanes at different speeds. Wait for a gap, then go.


5. **Watch for trains.** Train tracks look quiet until a train arrives, and trains move fast. Cross only when the track is clear.


6. **Cross the rivers.** Water lanes can’t be walked on. Time your hops so you land safely as you make your way across.


7. **Keep moving.** Your run ends when you get hit or fall into the water. The further you get, the higher your score.


You can also unlock different animal characters, each with its own personality. Characters change the look of your run, so pick the one you like best.


###### **Powerups**


Powerups give your run a boost when you need it most. Here’s what each one does:


- **Time Warp:** Slows all obstacles for a short while.


- **Rainbow Fart:** Launches you into the air for a safe crossing.


- **Ghost Mode:** Lets you pass through everything.


- **Magic Shield:** Absorbs one collision.


- **Dash Boots:** Makes you move 50% faster.


- **Score Multiplier:** Triples all incoming points.


###### **Ways to Compete**


Cross for Cash gives you a few ways to play, depending on your goals and where you live.


- **Practice games:** Free runs to learn lane patterns and sharpen your timing with no entry fee.


- **Virtual currency tournaments:** Compete against other players for in-game rewards. These are available even where cash competitions aren’t.


- **Cash tournaments:** Eligible players can pay an entry fee to compete for real cash prizes, where permitted by law. Availability varies by location.


- **Daily competitions and leaderboards:** Climb the daily rankings and see how your best runs stack up.


New to the game? We recommend starting with practice games until your runs feel consistent before entering a cash tournament.


###### **Tips to Raise Your Score**


The best Cross for Cash players aren’t the fastest tappers. They’re the most patient readers of the board.


- **Look two lanes ahead.** Before you hop, check the lane after the next one. A safe landing spot with no way forward can trap you.


- **Learn the rhythm.** Traffic in each lane moves at a steady pace. Watch one cycle before committing and you’ll spot the openings.


- **Pause when you need to.** Standing still on a safe lane is often smarter than a rushed hop into traffic.


- **Use your swipes.** Swiping back can get you out of trouble when a lane closes in front of you, and sidestepping can line you up with a safer path.


- **Respect the trains.** A clear track can change in an instant. If you’re unsure, wait it out.


- **Plan your river crossings.** Scan the whole river before your first hop so you know your path across.


- **Stay calm under pressure.** Your score only counts if you survive. A steady run beats a risky one almost every time.


- **Practice with purpose.** Use free games to work on your weakest obstacle, whether that’s trains, rivers, or fast traffic.


###### **Ready to Cross?**


Cross for Cash is easy to pick up and hard to master, which is exactly what makes it fun to compete in. Start with a few practice runs, learn the lanes, and then take on players at your level.


[Download Cross for Cash on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cross-for-cash-win-real-cash/id6796592507) and see how far you can go.
